svg.aria-label: Three-panel analysis of Unit Token Rate, Multi-Turn Context Amplification, and Per-Task AI Credit Breakdown across 28 GitHub Copilot models
svg.text: Layers 1 & 3 · Unit Token Multipliers × Agentic Loop Amplification = Task Compute Cost
From Token Price to Task Cost: Why Agentic Retry Loops Multiply Context Volume by 10×
112 agentic runs (28 models × 4 verified tasks). Total task credits = (Unit Credit Rate) × (Cumulative Multi-Turn Input & Output Tokens).
Note: Bottom 5 models (below dashed red line) failed the regex verifier. gemini-3.8-flash re-read 6.46M tokens across retries; claude-sonnet-5.5 needed only 588k input + 10.7k output tokens.
